Sankey diagram of taxon -> pathway-class contributions (PICRUSt2 stratified)

tax2fun_sankey.Rd

Builds an interactive Sankey diagram (via **networkD3**) showing flows from taxa (left) to pathway superclasses (right), using per-taxon-per-pathway differential results (e.g., PICRUSt2 stratified output summarized by MaAsLin2). Links are colored by effect direction (Up/Down). Node labels for left-side genera can be rendered **to the left of the rectangles** for readability.

Usage

tax2fun_sankey(
  pathway_sdaa_result,
  taxa_list = NULL,
  node_color = c(Up = "#F5BB7C", Down = "#B4CBE0"),
  node_neutral = NULL,
  label_left_sources = TRUE,
  margin = list(top = 10, right = 140, bottom = 10, left = 160),
  taxon_palette = microfun_palette("taxa"),
  function_palette = microfun_palette("function"),
  taxon_groups = NULL,
  tree_mode = c("none", "taxonomy", "phylogeny"),
  physeq = NULL,
  taxonomy = NULL,
  phylo_tree = NULL,
  tree_file = NULL,
  picrust2_dir = NULL,
  taxon_level = NULL,
  taxonomy_ranks = NULL,
  tree_tip_level = c("ASV", "taxon"),
  show_branch_length = TRUE,
  missing_taxa = c("error", "drop"),
  tree_options = list(),
  height = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  phylogeny_order = c("median", "first")
)

Arguments

pathway_sdaa_result

A named list where each name is a taxon and each element is a data.frame with at least the columns:

  • pathway_class Character; pathway superclass label (e.g., KEGG level-1).

  • logFC Numeric; effect sign/size used to color links (>\,0 = Up).

  • p_adjust Numeric; adjusted p-value (used only for filtering in user code).

Rows with NA in pathway_class are dropped.

taxa_list

Optional character vector of taxon names to include. Matching is case-insensitive. If supplied and none match, the function errors.

node_color

Named character vector of length 2 giving link/node colors for c(Up, Down) directions. Default: c(Up = '#F5BB7C', Down = '#B4CBE0').

node_neutral

Optional single colour overriding both node palettes. NULL (default) uses the light taxa and dark function palettes.

label_left_sources

Logical; if TRUE (default), place taxon labels on the **left** of left-column nodes and pathway labels on the **right** of right-column nodes. Implemented with a small htmlwidgets::onRender() D3 hook.

margin

A named list with top, right, bottom, left margins (pixels) passed to networkD3::sankeyNetwork(). Increase left when label_left_sources = TRUE to avoid clipping.

taxon_palette

Light taxon colours; optionally named by colour category.

function_palette

Dark function colours; optionally named by category.

taxon_groups

Optional named character vector mapping each taxon name to a taxonomy category such as Phylum. Without it, taxa are coloured by name.

tree_mode

Side tree: 'none' (networkD3), 'taxonomy', or 'phylogeny'.

physeq

Optional phyloseq object with original ASV taxonomy/tree.

taxonomy

Taxonomy data.frame/matrix; ASV row names or ASV/FeatureID column.

phylo_tree

A phylo object or named list of independent phylo trees.

tree_file

Newick file path(s). Each file must contain one tree.

picrust2_dir

PICRUSt2 output folder. Prefers reduced domain trees, then out.tre.

taxon_level

Rank inferred from recorded analysis settings; otherwise Genus. Use 'ASV' for ASV IDs.

taxonomy_ranks

Ordered ranks used for the taxonomic side tree; NULL uses available ancestors.

tree_tip_level

'ASV' matches tree tips to taxonomy row IDs; 'taxon' requires already taxon-labelled tips.

show_branch_length

Use available phylogenetic branch lengths; otherwise topology only.

missing_taxa

'error' (default) or 'drop' for taxa without matched tree tips.

tree_options

Named list: title, subtitle, font_size, font_family, tree_width, node_width, node_gap, show_tip_labels, tree_colour, link_opacity. Also accepts aggregate_links, collapse_clades, bundle_mapping and show_footer.

height, width

Optional tree-mode canvas dimensions in pixels.

phylogeny_order

Taxon ordering in phylogeny mode: 'median' (default) uses the median displayed ASV tip position; 'first' uses the first tip position. Median ties use the first tip position. Tree topology determines tip order. Used only in phylogeny mode.

Value

An htmlwidget Sankey graph (class htmlwidget) that can be viewed in RStudio Viewer or a web browser, and embedded in R Markdown/Quarto.

Details

The function constructs a long table of edges (taxon -> pathway class), assigns a link group 'Up' or 'Down' by the sign of logFC, builds unique node names, and then calls networkD3::sankeyNetwork(). A post-render D3 callback adjusts text anchors so that left-side labels appear to the left of their rectangles while right-side labels remain on the right. Nodes use the selected categorical palettes by default, and links retain their Up/Down colours. Named palettes preserve mappings across subsets.
